name: Recordando a Emily
source:
Remembering Emily is a short visual novel in which Thomas, the protagonist, relives his memories of Emily—memories that led him to her tragic end… although they might not be as clear as they first appear.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3698050/Remembering_Emily/]Steam[/url]]
